import sys
from xml.dom import minidom

path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Print all paragraphs with their pStyle and text
dom = minidom.parseString(content)
for i, p in enumerate(dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")):
    style = ""
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    if pPr:
        styles = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if styles:
            style = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            if t.firstChild:
                texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    txt = "".join(texts)
    print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={txt!r}")

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(".codex/skills/docx"))

from scripts.document import Document

TARGETS = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
changed = []

for text in sorted(TARGETS):
    p = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains=text)
    if p is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"headline paragraph not found: {text}")
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if not rprs:
            rpr = editor.dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        else:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            u = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
            changed.append(text)

doc.save()

print("underlined headlines:", sorted(set(changed)))

import sys
import zipfile
from xml.dom import minidom

TARGETS = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

docx_path = sys.argv[1]
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx_path) as z:
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml")

dom = minidom.parseString(xml)
found = {}
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            if t.firstChild:
                texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    txt = "".join(texts)
    if txt in TARGETS:
        runs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:r")
        underlined = all(
            r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            and r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u")
            for r in runs
        )
        found[txt] = (len(runs), underlined)

missing = TARGETS - set(found)
failures = [t for t, (n, ok) in found.items() if not ok or n == 0]
for t in sorted(found):
    n, ok = found[t]
    print(f"{t}: runs={n} underlined={ok}")
if missing:
    print("MISSING HEADLINES:", sorted(missing))
if missing or failures:
    sys.exit(1)
print("ALL HEADLINES UNDERLINED")

import sys
from xml.dom import minidom

PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

TARGETS = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

with open(PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    dom = minidom.parseString(f.read())

changed = []
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for p in paras:
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            if t.firstChild:
                texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    if "".join(texts) not in TARGETS:
        continue
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if not rprs:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        else:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
            changed.append("".join(texts))

with open(PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    dom.writexml(f, addindent="  ", newl="\n", encoding="UTF-8")

print("underlined:", sorted(set(changed)))
if not changed:
    sys.exit(1)

    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

    dom = minidom.parseString(f.read())

changed = []
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for p in paras:
    texts = []
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            if t.firstChild:
                texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    if "".join(texts) not in TARGETS:
        continue
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if not rprs:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        else:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
            changed.append("".join(texts))

with open(PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    dom.writexml(f, addindent="  ", newl="\n", encoding="UTF-8")

if not changed:
